digest.component_or_area: terraform-drift workflow and gerrit CI integration
propositions: terraform-drift.yml triggers (pull_request, push to main, schedule) do not fire for gerrit changes, so drift is not checked pre-submit
unapplied terraform resources can pass gerrit verification and merge to main, with drift detected only in post-merge workflow run
the gap is not closed by manual apply process or autodeploy, leaving infrastructure declared in HCL but absent from deployed state
a reviewer cannot distinguish from CI output alone whether a terraform change's resources are actually applied or only committed
the existing check uses -detailed-exitcode to fail on any drift, but cannot distinguish pre-submit between expected new resources and previously-committed unapplied ones
